items.html: But in the nursing there were other gradations in them. Namely, at first the Mochin were in the aspects of the simple Names of Elokim, and from Aleph-Lamed-Mem it became Elokim. It thus follows that the Mochin of Aleph-Lamed-Mem are of the pregnancy, and the Mochin of the Yod-Hei within the Aleph-Lamed-Mem are Mochin of the nursing, which are in their internality. And understand this well. But while they are still simple Names of Elokim, there is no distinction between this Mochin and that Mochin, except in the aspect of the form of the letter Hei of Elokim.
